dependency: Task 198 runner output, port 8012 eighteen-row proof and GitHub remote readback must exist before any Task 201 automation or queue contract is created.
geometry_policy: No new coordinates, polygons, building footprints or parcel boundaries are created or inferred. Every selected row remains NOT_BOUND.

features.name: Cliveden
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust official page identifies Cliveden, its house access, gardens and woodlands, and publishes Cliveden Road, Taplow, Maidenhead, Buckinghamshire, SL1 8NS. The page states that Cliveden House is leased as a luxury country hotel.
features.classification_finding: The principal historic house is real and address-supported, but the tracked destination includes a large estate and the house has hotel use. Detached Home taxonomy and principal-house-only scope require review before exact binding.

features.name: Polesden Lacey
features.official_source_evidence: The National Trust official page identifies Polesden Lacey as an Edwardian house within a large Surrey estate and publishes the Great Bookham property location.
features.classification_finding: The main house identity is authoritative, but the tracked visitor property includes estate land, gardens and visitor functions. The principal house must be isolated and Detached Home taxonomy reviewed.

features.name: 22 Bishopsgate
features.official_source_evidence: The named official building domain and authoritative current building records identify 22 Bishopsgate as a completed commercial tower whose predominant accommodation is office workspace.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is strongly supported. Amenities and public uses do not change the predominant office classification; exact binding must remain limited to the named tower footprint.

features.name: 1 New Street Square
features.official_source_evidence: Landsec is the primary owner and property source for 1 New Street Square; the named property page and published building records support commercial office use.
features.classification_finding: Office Building is supported, but the current owner page requires successful remote readback and the exact building must be separated from the wider New Street Square campus before geometry binding.

features.name: SEGRO Park Enfield
features.official_source_evidence: SEGRO is the authoritative industrial property operator; the tracked name refers to an industrial estate or park containing multiple units rather than one unit.
features.classification_finding: Industrial use is plausible, but the whole park cannot be classified and bound as one Industrial Unit. A current official property path and a named unit or defensible parcel are required.

features.name: Prologis Park Coventry
features.official_source_evidence: Prologis is the authoritative logistics property operator; authoritative published evidence identifies the Coventry site as a distribution park on the former colliery site.
features.classification_finding: Industrial and logistics use is supported, but Prologis Park Coventry is a multi-building distribution park. One named warehouse or exact industrial parcel must be selected before binding.
